artifacts.name: code-exploration
artifacts.description: SocratiCode exploration reference — full tool table, a pointer to the prefetch hook, per-tool notes, graph-health and index-scope guidance, plus this repo's measured graph yield and artifact inventory.

artifacts.name: database-schema
artifacts.description: PostgreSQL schema (Alembic migrations). Authoritative source for table definitions, columns, indexes, constraints, foreign keys, and JSONB/ARRAY column shapes.

artifacts.name: deployment-architecture
artifacts.description: Production deployment topology — its own VM since #43 (notifier.exe.xyz), not co-located with any consumer. Both endpoints bind this host's tailnet address alone: notifier.service on :9000 against the production database and notifier-dev.service on :9001 against notifier_dev, plus the two dead-man's-timer sweeps. Covers env file layout (/etc/notifier/.env vs the repo .env), the production-database opt-in, the memory reservation this 3.8 GiB no-swap host needs, and lifecycle commands.

artifacts.name: operational-runbook
artifacts.description: Operational command reference — uv/pytest/ruff/alembic invocations, dev server vs systemd workflow, env loading, and database migration procedures.

artifacts.name: systemd-unit
artifacts.description: systemd units and host config for the notifier service — notifier.service (production, :9000), notifier-dev.service (dev endpoint, :9001, notifier_dev), and the notifier-sweep{,-dev} timer/service pairs that run the dead-man's-timer sweep every 60s. Carries User, ExecStart, EnvironmentFile sources, restart bounds, which unit holds the production-database opt-in, and the memory reservation (MemoryLow/OOMScoreAdjust, 99-notifier-memory.conf, earlyoom.default). Authoritative for runtime config.
